page_title: HAV 0-0 MON | Le Havre v Monaco 24/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+3' The manager makes a subsitution with Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) coming on for Rassoul Ndiaye.
90+2' Wonderful movement by Le Havre. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
90' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' Caio Henrique (Monaco) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
85' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Thilo Kehrer (Monaco) was quite harsh and Marc Bollengier didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
83' Le Havre failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

82' Good clearance! Sofiane Boufal (Le Havre) received a low pass, but he didn't have time to do anything as one of the defenders quickly stole the ball off him. Le Havre force their opponents to concede a corner.
80' Enzo Koffi Vinette (Le Havre) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
78' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) attempts to discuss the decision with Marc Bollengier, but he soon realises that it's not the right thing to do as he sees the yellow.
77' Caio Henrique (Monaco) whips in a cross from the corner, but Lionel Mpasi-Nzau is well positioned and punches the ball away.
77' Caio Henrique (Monaco) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
76' The resulting corner, taken by Caio Henrique (Monaco), comes to nothing. The ball goes out of play. Monaco are awarded a corner kick.

76' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Monaco.
73' Ansu Fati (Monaco) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Le Havre.
72' Noam Obougou (Le Havre) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
70' Eric Dier has picked up an injury and is replaced by Jordan Teze (Monaco).
70' Looks like Eric Dier (Monaco) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
67' Monaco are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
65' Yanis Zouaoui goes off the pitch and Enzo Koffi Vinette (Le Havre) comes on.
65' Didier Digard decides to make a substitution. Kenny Quetant will be replaced by Sofiane Boufal (Le Havre).
65' Substitution. Noam Obougou (Le Havre) on for Felix Mambimbi.

64' Good team movement sets up Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) on the edge of the box, but he slices the ball narrowly wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Le Havre.
63' Le Havre show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted. The linesman signals a throw-in for Le Havre.
61' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) evades challenges and shoots from the edge of the box. It's a good effort, but flies just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Le Havre will have a goal kick.
59' Lamine Camara (Monaco) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
57' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
57' Sebastien Pocognoli prepares a substitution. Kassoum Ouattara is replaced by Vanderson (Monaco).
57' Substitution. Ansu Fati (Monaco) has come on for George Ilenikhena.

55' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Lamine Camara (Monaco), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Le Havre.
51' Le Havre show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted.
50' Kassoum Ouattara (Monaco) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
49' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) pounced on a rebound on the edge of the box and his shot goes a whisker over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Monaco will have a goal kick.
47' Wonderful movement by Le Havre. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
46' Didier Digard makes a half-time substitution. Issa Soumare (Le Havre) comes on in place of Ally Samatta.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+6' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Le Havre take a short corner kick.
45+2' Le Havre seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
45' 5 additional min. will be played.
45' Denis Zakaria (Monaco) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
43' Marc Bollengier blows his whistle for a foul after Eric Dier (Monaco) hacks down one of his opponents.
42' Monaco take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
41' George Ilenikhena (Monaco) latched on to a lofted pass inside the box, but his header misses to the right of the target. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Le Havre.
38' After the VAR review the referee signals NO PENALTY, play can continue.
36' There's a break in play and referee Marc Bollengier must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Monaco using VAR. This could be interesting!
35' Kassoum Ouattara (Monaco) struck the ball which rebounded to the edge of the box. His attempt went narrowly over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Le Havre will have a goal kick.
34' Monaco are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
32' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Loic Nego (Le Havre), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
30' George Ilenikhena (Monaco) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
29' Wout Faes is being substituted because of an injury. Sebastien Pocognoli sends Eric Dier (Monaco) on the pitch.
26' The resulting corner from Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre) is cleared by the opposition's defence.

26' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Le Havre are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
23' Wout Faes (Monaco) picks up an injury.
21' Marc Bollengier shows a yellow card to Kassoum Ouattara (Monaco) for his blatant foul.
21' Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.

19' Le Havre slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
17' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Le Havre.
16' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monaco. Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
14' Caio Henrique (Monaco) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
12' Felix Mambimbi (Le Havre) brings an opponent down and Marc Bollengier interrupts the game.
11' Le Havre are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
8' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) takes the rebound on the edge of the box and fires the ball just over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Le Havre will have a goal kick.
7' The free kick is delivered by Caio Henrique (Monaco) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
5' The resulting corner from Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre) comes to nothing.
3' Le Havre are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears. The ball has crossed the sideline. Le Havre are taking a throw-in.

3' Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monaco.
1' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Le Havre, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
